description: Add the theme infrastructure: CSS variable overrides for light mode in index.css, ThemeContext with localStorage persistence and system-preference detection, ThemeToggle component with sun/moon icons, and wire ThemeProvider into main.tsx. This is the foundation that FEAT-002 depends on.
steps:
STEP 4 — Modify frontend/src/main.tsx. Import ThemeProvider from './context/ThemeContext' and wrap the entire app (inside StrictMode, outside ErrorBoundary is fine, but inside is also OK). The ThemeProvider must wrap BrowserRouter so all route components can call useTheme(). Wrap the StrictMode content:

<StrictMode>
  <ThemeProvider>
    <ErrorBoundary>
      <BrowserRouter>...</BrowserRouter>
    </ErrorBoundary>
  </ThemeProvider>
</StrictMode>

This ensures applyTheme() runs before any component renders, preventing a flash of wrong theme.
